title: PCA Exam Strategy & Keyword Elimination — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces Step-by-Step Question Deconstruction Traversal: read stem -> identify constraint modifiers -> eliminate distractors -> select Google recommended answer.
routing_rationale: Systematic elimination consistently narrows questions down from 4 possibilities to 1 unambiguous winning answer in under 60 seconds.

nodes.label: Question: 'Migrate on-prem VM rapidly'
nodes.detail: Must migrate 200 Windows VMs to Google Cloud within 30 days.

nodes.label: Discard: 'Rewrite to Cloud Functions'
nodes.detail: Rewriting 200 applications in 30 days is unrealistic; violates 'minimal refactoring'.

nodes.label: Discard: 'Export OVA & upload to GCS'
nodes.detail: Manual export/import causes days of downtime per server.

nodes.label: Select: Migrate to Virtual Machines
nodes.detail: Replicates live VM disks in background; automated cutover with minimal downtime.

steps.title: Modifier Elimination
steps.action: Filters options that violate timeline or require excessive engineering refactoring.
steps.why_traversal: Eliminates options that sound technically impressive but violate practical business constraints.

steps.title: Tooling Confirmation
steps.action: Selects Google's purpose-built migration service (M4VM) as the intended solution.
steps.why_traversal: Guarantees full alignment with exam grading key.

scenarios.label: Selected Deprecated Velostrata / M4CE Name
scenarios.root_cause: Candidate memorized outdated product name (Velostrata) instead of current Migrate to Virtual Machines.
scenarios.recovery: Study modern Google Cloud product branding: Migrate to Virtual Machines (v5.x).
